reasoning: Inputs are an integral finite free module L, its integral endomorphism A, integral monic f,g, mapped coprimality over K, and actual characteristic factorization. No integral-clearing premise or evaluated-certificate premise is supplied.
integral_resultant_projector constructs actual resultant Bezout polynomials and separator E, including idempotence, exact kernel and range, and resultant clearing on the natural tensor-image lattice.
Nonzero resultant in O is derived from mapped_resultant_nonzero: a zero O resultant would map to zero, contradiction. This avoids treating valuation(0).

original_clearing_weight_at_valuation is applied to the actual tensorLattice O-submodule. Its proof writes nonzero resultant as unit times pi^s, uses addVal_def to identify s, and multiplies by the inverse unit, so the exact normalized valuation exponent is obtained.

The final conversion from scalar multiplication of a K-linear map to the O-action on its value uses LinearMap.smul_apply and algebraMap_smul. It does not replace the lattice or change the quotient domain.
scope_notes: The statement is on K tensor_O L and the literal image of L under y maps to 1 tensor y. It is not a theorem already written for an arbitrary separately supplied ambient embedding Lambda subset V. It is the canonical finite-free scalar-extension model used by the upstream integral theorem.
The theorem needs no IsFractionRing premise and is valid more generally for the declared field algebra. The manuscript fraction-field setting is a specialization.
The corollary asserts an upper denominator bound, not sharpness of the resultant valuation; the source makes the same assertion. Unit resultants and zero-dimensional modules are retained.
